items.title: File Einspruch against the Kraftfahrzeugsteuerbescheid
items.quote: Er ist innerhalb eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe bei der erlassenden Behörde schriftlich oder elektronisch einzulegen.
items.computation: Letter dated Fri 27.12.2024, sent by post by a tax authority. Under §122 Abs. 2 Nr. 1 AO (as in force in December 2024, before the 2025 change to 4 days), the letter counts as delivered on the 3rd day after posting: Fri 27.12.2024 + 3 days = Mon 30.12.2024, which is itself confirmed as the delivery/Bekanntgabe day matching the letter's own wording ('dritten Tag nach Aufgabe zur Post'). Per §187 Abs.1 BGB / §108 Abs.1 AO the day of delivery (30.12.2024) is not counted; the one-month Einspruch period under §355 AO then runs to the same numbered day one month later: Thu 30.01.2025. That day is a normal working day (no weekend/holiday shift needed under §108 Abs.3 AO), so the deadline stays 30.01.2025.

items.title: Annual Kraftfahrzeugsteuer collected by direct debit
items.quote: Die Steuer wird jährlich im Voraus durch Lastschrift eingezogen.
items.computation: The letter sets the annual tax at 186,00 € starting 01.01.2025 and states it will be collected 'jährlich im Voraus' (annually in advance) by direct debit (Lastschrift), but it does not print an exact collection date within the annual period beginning 01.01.2025. No action is required from the recipient other than ensuring the account has sufficient funds; the exact debit date cannot be determined from this letter.

warnings: The letter states the tax is collected automatically by Lastschrift (direct debit) rather than asking for a manual transfer, so the printed IBAN is for reference/verification only and no payment action is needed unless the direct debit fails; still, always compare bank details with earlier official correspondence before ever paying manually.

The exact date of the annual direct-debit collection for the 186,00 € tax is not stated in the letter, only that it happens 'jährlich im Voraus' from 01.01.2025; check bank statements or contact the Hauptzollamt if this is unclear.
